Since 12 Oct the spec says a shift counts as a whole-work-order shift when it "covers every current line".
(a) A work order with only one line: does a shift on that line count as a whole-work-order shift?
(b) A shift made with Choose lines that ticks every line: does it count?
(c) Do lines that are not approved, or are declined, count as "current lines"?
(d) If a line is added after an Entire work order shift was made, does that shift still count?
On the Schedule a one-line work order is booked at once as a whole. Four test cases depend on (a).
